lyrics:
[Verse 1]  
My sweet little girl, a sandalwood glow, my heart’s closest beat, my whole world, (Roman: My sweet li-tul gurl, a san‑dal‑wood glo, my harts clos‑ist beet, my hohl wurld)  
Your words drift like honey, soft, pure, and true. (Roman: Yor wurdz drift lyke hun‑ee, soft, pyur, and troo)  
Little princess, a chest of bright wonder, (Roman: Lit‑ul prin‑ses, a chest uv brite wun‑der)  
A lantern of grace that lights up our night. (Roman: A lan‑tern uv greys that lyts up owr nite)  

[Refrain]  
You wear a mother’s gentle smile, divine grace in your eyes, (Roman: Yoo wer a mu‑therz jen‑tle smyl, di‑vine greys in yor eyez)  
A precious bloom, the light that guides my soul. (Roman: A preh‑shus blo͞om, the lyte that gy‑dz my soul)  
From cradle’s hush to shoulders strong, you’ve grown, (Roman: From cray‑dls hush to shoul‑ders strong, yuv grohn)  
A soaring bird, a woman now in flight. (Roman: A so‑ring berd, a woo‑mən now in fyt)  

[Verse 2]  
My darling child, that fragrant lamp, my nearest kin, my life’s refrain, (Roman: My dar‑ling chyd, that fra‑grant lamp, my neer‑ist kin, my lyf’s re‑frayn)  
Your voice is honey‑sweet, it fills the air. (Roman: Yor vois iz hun‑ee‑sweet, it fills the air)  
Little princess, a box of endless magic, (Roman: Lit‑ul prin‑ses, a boks uv end‑less maj‑ik)  
A blessed glow that steadies every storm. (Roman: A bles‑d glow that stee‑diz ev‑ry storm)  

[Refrain]  
When loneliness claws, you are the song inside me, (Roman: When lone‑lin‑ess claws, yoo ar the song in‑side mee)  
When sorrow strikes, your smile heals the night. (Roman: When sor‑row strikes, yor smyl heals the nite)  
Flawed as I am, you marvel at my heart, (Roman: Flawd az I am, yoo mar‑vel at my hart)  
Even when I cannot love myself, you hold me close. (Roman: Ee‑ven wen I cannot luv my‑self, yoo hoʊld mee klohs)  

[Refrain]  
You wear a mother’s gentle smile, divine grace in your eyes, (Roman: Yoo wer a mu‑therz jen‑tle smyl, di‑vine greys in yor eyez)  
A precious bloom, the light that guides my soul. (Roman: A preh‑shus blo͞om, the lyte that gy‑dz my soul)  
From cradle’s hush to shoulders strong, you’ve grown, (Roman: From cray‑dls hush to shoul‑ders strong, yuv grohn)  
A soaring bird, a woman now in flight. (Roman: A so‑ring berd, a woo‑mən now in fyt)
